campaign_objective: Launch the Nike Air Max Dn to Gen Z with a TikTok-first campaign that feels raw and real, not polished, highlighting its Dynamic Air technology.

target_audience.primary: Gen Z, aged 18-24, interested in sneaker culture and streetwear.

mandatory_elements: visible Air unit in every shot
Nike swoosh visible in first and last 3 seconds
Product shot of Nike Air Max Dn in volt green and total orange colorways
brief_gaps: Specific call to action (CTA) for the video
Guidance on music style or audio trends to leverage on TikTok
Specific visual examples or creative references for 'raw and real' aesthetic
Details on specific product benefits beyond 'Dynamic Air'
Brand tagline (if different from key message)
